text:
sam_j: Kicking off Argento POC. Need a one-pager: success criteria, owner matrix, golden-set sample, scoring rubric, and regression gate. Who owns scoring and security?

liz_de: I can own the one-pager + owner matrix. Recommend Hosted to start unless they require SLAs immediately.

maria_se: I'll draft golden prompts. Proposed 3 use cases: support triage, form autofill (KYC), contract clause extraction. Will include edge cases and adversarial negatives. CSV format: prompt | expected | tags | difficulty | canonical_id.

tao_ml: I'll own scoring. Quick rubric: field-exact / field-F1 for structured outputs; embedding cosine >=0.82 for freeform; 10% human spot-check target >=4/5. Regression gate: >5pt drop vs baseline -> block and open ticket.

ben_ops: Security lead here. Argento needs CMEK, EU data residency, SOC2. I'll start the infosec questionnaire answers and a KMS/peering plan.

sam_j: Procurement Q: can we run a 2-week Hosted trial and only bill Dedicated if they commit? Need delta estimate for Dedicated.

liz_de: Yes. I'll model two scenarios (Hosted trial -> Dedicated commit vs Hosted-only) and post numbers. Expect ~12-18% unit uplift for Dedicated.

maria_se: Timeline: sample CSV (15 goldens per use case) Tue EOD. Will include canonical IDs for regression tracking.

tao_ml: I'll run baseline on goldens once Maria posts and add dashboard tile for pass rate; wire alert to PagerDuty for gate trips.

ops-bot: Event created: Argento POC sync — Thu 10:00am PT. Invite sent. :calendar: 

sam_j: TL;DR next steps: Maria (goldens CSV), Tao (scoring + baseline), Ben (infosec answers + KMS plan), Liz (one-pager + owner matrix), Liz & Sam (pricing scenarios). Present for signoff on Thu to start 2-week Hosted trial. :thumbsup:
